system.summary: Pandolfini's 1514-15 embassy cipher (Dudout, pandolfini1514): consonant signs carry the vowel as a superscript figure 1-5 = u o i e a; bare vowel signs; homophones (n = y, t; l = x, c; r = 7, d; t = 8, Z); doubling by a double bar; word signs F et, M non, α per, D che, D^n con, B ancora, T^m Sua Maestà; numbers between points for names: 22 occurrences of 5 distinct groups in this letter (.4. Cristianissimo 10, .20. Svizeri 7, .2. papa 3; .15. 1 and .22. 1, unread).
system.notes: distinct_symbols counts distinct base shapes (superscripts stripped). key_frozen.tsv = Dudout's key_v6.json unchanged plus three shape aliases (92 lines: 2 comment lines and 90 entries); key.tsv adds only Φ = x (92 lines: 1 comment line and 91 entries). nomenclator.entries counts the distinct number groups used in this letter.

solution.what: cc. 674r-674 bis v fetched from the ASF MAP IIIF service at full size (A0001463-A0001466).
Catalogue vetting record of 6 Nov 2026 and one web search: no edition or decipherment of the letter.
Pass 1 from 2x strips (674r before any decoding); pass 2 from 2.5x strips with other framing; 19 places changed and settled on the strip.
Dudout's key v6 (targets/pandolfini1514/key_v6.json) imported unchanged and frozen (key_frozen.tsv) with three shape aliases; one sign (Φ = x) added from context in key.tsv.

Whole letter held out from v6: Dan's checker on the unspaced frozen-key decryption, re-run on the final files, gives coverage 0.820 against 0.629-0.685 for five keys with shuffled consonant values (clean share 0.925 against 0.702-0.848; that measure is lenient). Two passages compared with the clear parts of the letter: the Swiss terms of the Gallarate agreement in the cipher of 674v against the clear summary on 674 bis r (the sum, [?novecento] mila against the clear 'un milione d'oro', stays doubtful), and 'lo accordo era concluso' in the cipher of 674 bis v against the clear postscript on 674v.

Reading with every departure marked; scripts/check_marks.py passes. 771 words: 592 verbatim, 137 with a marked repair, 15 conjectural, 27 holes. Dan's checker: clean share 0.681 (64 of 94 sentences) on the marked reading, 0.734 (47 of 64) with the marks resolved and conjectures left out.

Independent blind review by an AI language-model agent that took no part in the solution: sign spot-check of about 150 signs in four lines on the images (base shapes agree in about 95%), mechanical checks re-run, reading read against the translation. Read in part, grade B. Of five signs the reviewer read differently, two were marked doubtful after a second look at the strips and three were kept (NOTES.md).

Integration check (round 7): reran decrypt/check_marks/heldout (0.820 vs 0.629-0.685, 592 of 771 verbatim), _check_reading (0.681) and _check_profile; own second decoder from key.tsv gives an identical decryption; frozen-key and transcription hashes match. ASF images unreachable from the checking session (connection reset), so no image comparison. Strict share 76.8% kept as the figure (94.6% with marked repairs is the contributor's looser figure). Known keys v3/v4 of pandolfini1514 differ from v6 only by token additions. Status set to in progress: no independent blind transcription is a workable gap.

texts.label: 6 and 8 Sept 1515, MAP CXXXVII 666, cc. 674r-674 bis v
texts.summary: Pandolfini at Vercelli, the week before Marignano (inferred from the dates): he follows the pope's orator, who will not go on to the King until the pope changes course. The French camp near Bufalora moves towards Biagrasso (Abbiategrasso); envoys of Milan offer victuals, but the hoped-for goodwill of Milan does not show and the King is angry. The Duke of Savoy, the Bastard of Savoy, Lautrec and 'the general who was of Milan' (identified by the contributor as Sebastiano Ferrier) go to the Swiss camp near Gallarate for the answer. The terms of the agreement: a state, a pension, a hundred lances and a wife of the King's blood for the Duke of Milan; money in instalments over six years and a yearly pension for the Swiss, Swiss kept in the King's pay. Milan is as good as won and the King may try Naples this year; the Duke of Milan will not accept the offer and may end a prisoner. Postscript: the Duke of Guelders has arrived; the agreement is reported concluded, the Spaniards have left, the French camp moves towards Lodi.
texts.note: Words 771: 592 verbatim (76.8%), 137 with a marked repair, 15 conjectural, 27 holes (about 41 words by length). Codes .15. and .22. unread. Transcription not blind after pass 1 of 674r.

reading_review.note: The text reads as sentences and holds against the clear parts and the history; 21 of about 24 sentences are coherent, with many marked repairs, some conjectures and three broken passages (v01-v02, v08-v09, b03-b06). Read in part is right; read is not.
